name: AVK
industry_role: Data-centre power supplier: standby generators (Rolls-Royce mtu), modular electrical PowerPods, on-site microgrids and behind-the-meter energy-as-a-service
description: UK and European supplier of power systems for data centres; Partners Group took a majority stake in August 2026 with an initial investment of more than USD 1bn to build an energy-as-a-service platform around a pipeline of more than 2 GW of behind-the-meter opportunities. Built a 110 MW on-site microgrid for Pure DC's Dublin campus (announced March 2026).
notes: Ward client (AVK|SEG in Clockwork: VP Delivery and Operations Director UK & Europe searches). Sits between energy and data centres: designs, installs and maintains data-centre power - standby generation, modular electrical PowerPods (Ward's team calls them ePods), and on-site prime power sold as energy-as-a-service.
